gloss: chief; head (of a station, office, or bureau)

definitions.gloss: chief; head (of a station, office, or bureau)
definitions.explanation: chief; head (of a station, office, or bureau)

examples.japanese: {警察|けいさつ}{署長|しょちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就任|しゅうにん}→就任：12368_shuunin⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
{消防|しょうぼう}{署長|しょちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{記者|きしゃ}{会見|かいけん}→記者会見：19954_kishakaiken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The fire chief held a press conference.

examples.japanese: {税務|ぜいむ}{署長|しょちょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{許可|きょか}→許可：00259_kyoka⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦なければ→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{処理|しょり}できない→処理する：25531_shorisuru⟧。
examples.english: Without the permission of the head of the tax office, these documents cannot be processed.

notes:
The head or chief of a {署|しょ} (station/bureau). Most commonly used in the compound {警察|けいさつ}{署長|しょちょう} (police chief), but applies to any government {署|しょ} such as ⟦{消防|しょうぼう}{署|しょ}→消防署：06454_shoubousho⟧ (fire station) or ⟦{税務|ぜいむ}{署|しょ}→税務署：13782_zeimusho⟧ (tax office).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {警察|けいさつ}{署長|しょちょう}: police chief
- {消防|しょうぼう}{署長|しょちょう}: fire chief
- {税務|ぜいむ}{署長|しょちょう}: head of tax office
- {署長|しょちょう}⟦{命令|めいれい}→命令：03754_meirei⟧: chief's order

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {所長|しょちょう}: director, head of an office or institute — used for research institutes, branch offices, etc.
- ⟦{局長|きょくちょう}→局長：20023_kyokuchou⟧: bureau chief, director — used for larger government agencies and broadcasting stations
- {長官|ちょうかん}: commissioner, chief — used for top-ranking government officials
